cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(DualTensorRTPlugins LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)
find_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)
set(TRT_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Native TensorRT SDK root (not the other OS SDK)")
find_path(TRT_INCLUDE NvInfer.h HINTS "${TRT_ROOT}/include" PATHS /usr/include /usr/include/x86_64-linux-gnu REQUIRED)
find_library(TRT_LIBRARY NAMES nvinfer_11 nvinfer_10 nvinfer HINTS "${TRT_ROOT}/lib" "${TRT_ROOT}/lib/x64" PATHS /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu REQUIRED)
foreach(key IN ITEMS DUAL_C DUAL_H DUAL_W DUAL_SM)
  if(NOT DEFINED ${key} OR NOT "${${key}}" MATCHES "^[0-9]+$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Provide numeric -D${key}=...")
  endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT EXISTS "${DUAL_AOT_DIR}/Core.h" OR NOT EXISTS "${DUAL_AOT_DIR}/Project.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Generate reviewed AOT headers first with scripts.dual_tensorrt.aot")
endif()
set(DUAL_KEY "c${DUAL_C}_h${DUAL_H}_w${DUAL_W}")
foreach(part IN ITEMS Norm Core Project AttentionBarrier)
  if(part STREQUAL "Norm")
    set(src Norm.cu)
  else()
    set(src "${part}.cpp")
  endif()
  set(target "Dual${part}")
  add_library(${target} SHARED "${src}")
  target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE "${TRT_INCLUDE}")
  target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE "${TRT_LIBRARY}" CUDA::cuda_driver CUDA::cudart)
  target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE DUAL_C=${DUAL_C} DUAL_H=${DUAL_H} DUAL_W=${DUAL_W} DUAL_SM=${DUAL_SM} DUAL_KEY="${DUAL_KEY}")
  set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 CUDA_STANDARD 17 CUDA_ARCHITECTURES "${DUAL_SM}-real;${DUAL_SM}-virtual")
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:--fmad=false>)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:/EHsc>)
  endif()
endforeach()
target_compile_definitions(DualCore PRIVATE DUAL_AOT_HEADER="${DUAL_AOT_DIR}/Core.h")
target_compile_definitions(DualProject PRIVATE DUAL_PROJECT_HEADER="${DUAL_AOT_DIR}/Project.h")
